title: Mermaid waving hello
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- hair -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="30" rx="18" ry="20" fill="#e8437a"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="30" rx="16" ry="18" fill="#e8437a"/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="14" fill="#ffd9b3"/>
  <!-- hair top -->
  <path d="M36 28 Q38 14 50 12 Q62 14 64 28 Q60 20 50 18 Q40 20 36 28Z" fill="#e8437a"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#3a2a6a"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#3a2a6a"/>
  <circle cx="45.8" cy="33.2" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="55.8" cy="33.2" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M45 40 Q50 45 55 40" stroke="#c94a6a" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="39" r="2.5" fill="#ff9db3" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="39" r="2.5" fill="#ff9db3" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- body / top -->
  <path d="M40 48 Q50 44 60 48 L62 62 Q50 66 38 62 Z" fill="#28b8a8"/>
  <!-- shells -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="52" r="4" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="52" r="4" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#ffefb0"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#ffefb0"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M38 60 Q30 72 36 84 Q42 92 50 92 Q58 92 64 84 Q70 72 62 60 Q56 66 50 66 Q44 66 38 60Z" fill="#2e9e8a"/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d="M36 84 Q24 90 22 96 Q30 96 38 90 Q36 87 36 84Z" fill="#5fd6c2"/>
  <path d="M64 84 Q76 90 78 96 Q70 96 62 90 Q64 87 64 84Z" fill="#5fd6c2"/>
  <!-- tail scales -->
  <path d="M44 70 Q50 74 56 70" stroke="#5fd6c2" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M42 78 Q50 82 58 78" stroke="#5fd6c2" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M45 86 Q50 89 55 86" stroke="#5fd6c2" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- left arm down -->
  <path d="M40 50 Q32 58 30 66" stroke="#ffd9b3" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d="M60 50 Q70 44 76 36 Q80 30 78 24" stroke="#ffd9b3" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="22" r="4" fill="#ffd9b3"/>
  <line x1="77" y1="18" x2="76" y2="14" stroke="#ffd9b3" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="19" x2="81" y2="15" stroke="#ffd9b3" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="75" y1="21" x2="72" y2="19" stroke="#ffd9b3" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx="84" cy="20" r="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#7ee8ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="28" r="1.8" fill="none" stroke="#7ee8ff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="32" r="1.3" fill="none" stroke="#7ee8ff" stroke-width="0.9"/>
  <!-- hair strand -->
  <path d="M60 26 Q68 34 66 46" stroke="#e8437a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
